dict.string: MacSpaces uses AppleScript for explicitly requested Messages replies, meeting controls, quick actions, Music playlist controls, unread counts, and media metadata from Music, Spotify, or your active browser when system-wide media info is unavailable.
MacSpaces reads your already-paired Bluetooth devices to show their battery levels in the Battery widget. It does not scan for or track nearby devices.
MacSpaces shows today's events in the Calendar widget.
MacSpaces shows today's events in the Calendar widget.
MacSpaces uses the camera for the notch Mirror tab so you can quickly check yourself before a call.
MacSpaces uses your location to show local weather. Coordinates are only sent to the Open-Meteo forecast API.

MacSpaces uses the microphone only when you start on-device dictation or voice-following teleprompter. Audio stays on your Mac.
MacSpaces shows and completes reminders in the Todos widget.
